summary: Iteration 61 verifies the Phase-1 Aug-2026 two-account-type rules. BACKEND — 9 / 10 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter61_two_account_types.py, junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter61_two_account_types.xml). PASS: two_account_types_migration_2026_08 completed (0 role='user' + registration_paid=true + registration_source in [upi_manual,offline_cash] left; historical registration_fee txns preserved); GET /admin/users/source-counts returns the new keys subscriber=3, non_subscriber=24, legacy=0, all=28; POST /admin/users/create with a valid referral_code produces registration_paid=false + registration_source=None + paid_at=None + subscription_skipped=true + referral_enabled=false, writes ZERO registration_fee / gst_collected / system_wallet_deposits rows, and /admin/transactions/summary?type=registration_fee total_count+total_amount and /admin/finance/net-worth group_1_revenue+group_3_gst are byte-identical before vs after the create; POST /admin/users/{id}/referral-approval requires min_length=3 note (422 without note, 422 with 2-char note); commissions do NOT fire while referral_enabled=false (0 referral_payout / direct_signup_credit txns after DB-flipping registration_paid=true with referral_enabled=false); switching Admin Approved ON via the endpoint returns commissions_triggered=true, writes a referral_switch_history entry, and creates at least one referral_payout for the paid subscriber sponsor's upline; switching OFF returns clawback {clawed_back_count, clawed_back_amount, platform_fee_reversed} that matches the sum of the fired payouts to the rupee (recipient wallet_balance -= net, total_earned -= net, refund_debt increased when wallet went negative, a refund_clawback txn per payout, the original payout status='reversed' with reversed_by pointer, and platform_fee_reversal + admin bucket debit written when platform_fee_amount>0). GET /admin/export/users CSV contains the new columns account_type, paid_status, join_source, admin_approved, admin_approved_note, admin_approved_on, admin_approved_by, no literal 'None' values, and the OFF note ('Refund done · iter61 clawback scenario') appears on the scenario member row. FAIL: PATCH /admin/users/{id} is NOT enforcing registration_paid immutability — sending {registration_paid:false} on a paid user returns 200 and FLIPS registration_paid to false (also with {registration_paid:false,phone:...}) — the AdminUserUpdate model still exposes registration_paid and admin_update_user() applies it. This is a critical spec violation (the frontend edit slide already removed the switch but the API is still writable) — see rca_of_issue below. FRONTEND (390x844 web preview) — verified against the preview URL: /admin/users renders the four category tabs 'All 28 · Subscribers 3 · No subscription 24 · Legacy' (Legacy is present with count 0 because the current implementation filters only when legacy count is not undefined — noted below), 'Add new user' button label is just 'Add new user' (NO '(offline-paid)'), the modal contains the 5 fields (name/email/password/phone/sponsor) + a 'Non-subscriber' info box and has NO 'Mark registration fee as paid' switch / NO offline-cash · Razorpay · UPI-manual chips / NO UTR field. Creating a user via the modal (ui_iter61_234062@test.com) hit POST /admin/users/create and the resulting DB row has registration_paid=false, registration_source=None, subscription_skipped=true, referral_enabled=false, paid_at=None. Editing a subscriber (seed.razorpay.1@example.com) shows testID edit-paid-status containing '₹118 PAID' with NO edit-paid-switch, plus the edit-referral-switch and the 'Last note: “Seeded ON from existing approval” · 9/1/2026' line (testID edit-referral-note). Regression check: POST /api/auth/register creates a new user with paid=false + skip=None + src=None; /payment/config still returns amount=118 / is_mock=true — the /payment screen renders the SUBSCRIPTION hero (verified in iter60 with the same code path, and /app/frontend/app/payment.tsx no longer references /payment-upi anywhere).

critical.issue: registration_paid is NOT immutable — sending {registration_paid:false} on a paid subscriber returns 200 and flips registration_paid to false (spec: must return 400 'No fields provided' when sent alone, and be ignored when sent alongside other fields). Root cause: AdminUserUpdate (models.py:198) still exposes `registration_paid: Optional[bool]` and admin_update_user (server.py:3073-3116) does not pop it from `update`. Contrast with POST /users/me/bank which does `update.pop('registration_paid', None)` at server.py:1980. Fix: pop it in admin_update_user right after building `update`, then re-check `if not update` for the 'no fields' path.

ui_bugs.issue: The Legacy tab is rendered with count 0 even though the filter `.filter(t => t.key !== 'legacy' || (sourceCounts?.legacy || 0) > 0)` at /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx:169 should hide it. Reason: server currently returns legacy=0 (all legacy users converted), so (sourceCounts.legacy || 0) === 0 → filter should return false. In practice the tab still shows in the DOM — probably because sourceCounts is still null on first paint or because the filter is evaluated too eagerly. Non-blocking; the tab is empty and clicking it just shows an empty list.

action_items: CRITICAL: enforce registration_paid immutability in PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}. Simplest fix (matches the pattern at server.py:1980): inside admin_update_user() right after `update = {k: v for k, v in payload.dict().items() if v is not None}` add `update.pop('registration_paid', None)` before the `if not update: raise HTTPException(400, ...)` check. This makes the endpoint behave per the review-request contract (sending {registration_paid:false} alone → 400, sending it alongside another field → the other field applies but paid stays true). No frontend change needed — /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx already omits registration_paid from the PATCH payload.
OPTIONAL: hide the 'Legacy' source tab entirely when sourceCounts.legacy is 0 — currently it renders as an empty pill (see /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx:164-169).

OPTIONAL: the AdminUserUpdate Pydantic model still declares `registration_paid: Optional[bool] = None` (models.py:208) — after the immutability fix, consider dropping the field from the model too so it 422s at parse time rather than silently ignoring.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_update_user missing `update.pop('registration_paid', None)` — see FAIL above.

server.py:8042-8053 does a fallback backfill setting registration_source='offline_cash' on any user with registration_paid=true and no source. After the two-account-type migration this backfill can no longer fire (the migration converts all such users to registration_paid=false), so the logic is now dead code that should be removed to reduce confusion.

AdminCreateUserRequest (models.py:328) still has mark_paid_offline (default True), registration_source (default 'offline_cash'), and utr fields even though admin_create_user (server.py:4925) ignores them and always creates a non-subscriber. Consider removing these fields entirely so the API contract is unambiguous.

rca_of_issue: PATCH /api/admin/users/{id} accepts and applies {registration_paid:false} on a paid subscriber. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login (support@slangcart.com/3)Ywxtic) → get admin JWT → PATCH /api/admin/users/<any razorpay-paid user id> with body {"registration_paid":false} → response is 200 and the returned document has registration_paid:false; the DB row is also flipped. Root cause: server.py admin_update_user (line 3073) builds `update` from all non-None payload fields and applies it verbatim to the users doc. The Aug-2026 spec makes registration_paid immutable at this endpoint (see the /users/me/bank sibling at server.py:1980 which correctly pops it), but the pop was never added to admin_update_user. Impact: an admin (or any caller with the admin JWT) can silently mark a paid subscriber as unpaid, breaking the 'once a Razorpay payment succeeded the member is a Subscriber for life' invariant and (b) allow the user to be re-billed through /payment or (c) desynchronise the treasury (registration_fee txn stays but the user shows unpaid, so /admin/finance/net-worth and /admin/users/source-counts diverge). Mitigation: in admin_update_user() after building `update`, add `update.pop('registration_paid', None)` then keep the existing `if not update: raise HTTPException(400, 'No fields provided')`. Optional: also remove the field from AdminUserUpdate so it 422s at model-parse time. No frontend change is needed — /app/frontend/app/admin/users.tsx already omits registration_paid from its PATCH payload. Regression test already lives in test_iter61_two_account_types.py::test_patch_admin_users_registration_paid_is_immutable — it will turn green once the pop is added.
